cim: How To Govern Artificial Intelligence Without Government
cim_eredeti: How To Govern Artificial Intelligence Without Government
szoveg_eredeti:
Major charitable foundations—joined by philanthropies from the right, the left, and the tech world—should establish and endow an independent institution to govern frontier AI. The nonprofit corporation would not tax the AI firms, and the firms would not govern it. (For more detail, see the full proposal here.) The new institution would do three things.

[Reed Hundt was Chairman of the FCC from 1993-1997 and is currently the CEO and Board Chair of Refounding America, a nonpartisan, nonprofit 501(c)(3) designing changes to the structure and function of government. Blair Levin was Chief of Staff to the then FCC Chairman Hundt and is on the Board of Directors of Refounding America.]
